_provenance.page_anatomy_correction: CORRECTION (2026-10-01): every field in page_anatomy is re-verified token-by-token against data/live_salphaseion.txt (1075 one-character tokens). The certified segments are UNCHANGED and were used as the witness: raw[0:91]==dbbib_91; raw[91:195] decodes to 'matrixsumlist'; raw[766:829]==z_segment_1; raw[830:859]==z_segment_2; raw[959:999] decodes to 'enter'; z separators at tokens 765, 829, 859, 958 all confirmed. FIVE boundary errors were corrected, all in the 860-1074 tail, none touching the certified streams: (1) the literal phrase is 860-894 (35 tokens), not 860-896; (2) the base64 half starts at 895, not 897 - raw[897:958] is 61 chars and is INVALID base64; (3) token 958 is not a word separator but the final base64 character of that half, since dropping it yields 'Incorrect padding'; (4) the assembled blob is 96 bytes Salted__, salt 3ab585348552415d, sha256 9e2831e1b34b5f34796df47ccaf6530d48d371c61a6bff84d60db1064fa7a258, and it is NOT the CosmicDuality blob with salt 2d3f6fe06dc950e6 that the old label named; (5) the base64 tail ends at 1062, and tokens 1063-1074 are the literal letters 'shabefanstoo', not base64. See analysis/tested.md R-PAGEANATOMY-2026-10-01.

faed_570_len_note: CORRECTED 2026-10-01: the field name is a misnomer, the 571 is right.
